title: Young Lit Hippy - Symbolize
htmlContent:
Young Lit Hippy recently revealed another hit single titled "Symbolize." Having spent most of his life grinding his artistry, the multi-faceted singer is now on the threshold of a significant breakthrough.

"Symbolize" is the perfect doorway for the young rapper who has been working as hard as ever. Besides, the vocals are astonishing, with solid hooks and fantastic harmonies.

Young Lit Hippy "Symbolize" is available on all streaming platforms!

Artist Short Bio:

Young Lit Hippy from Portland, Oregon, has an energetic trap, soul, and hip-hop influence and an uplifting, catchy soul vibe incorporated into his music. During the pandemic, Young Lit Hippy decided to dive deeper into the engineering and production flank of music and ended up releasing 41 songs which included four projects. His single "Superman" gained recognition and was published on "Earmilk," and his most triumphant project release was the last one titled "Psychological Warfare," which has accumulated over 243k streams.
